title: Track Guide Summit Point - Jefferson 53.3 Mazda MX5 iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Break at the tree on the right, 90% brake pressure, trail to curb.
corners.line: Turn-in at curb, let car roll, exit mid-track.
corners.exit: Get on throttle as exit, aim mid-track.
corners.mistakes: People will try to overtake in race.

corners.label: T2
corners.line: Cut inside curb, lift throttle, repeat for second part.
corners.exit: End up mid-track for turn three.

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: Start braking where inside curb changes color, 80% brake pressure.
corners.exit: Accelerate gently to avoid spinning, aim mid-track.

corners.label: T4
corners.mistakes: Car wants to go sideways, be careful.

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: Brake at last three on left, 65% brake pressure, trail to inside curb.
corners.mistakes: Do not overtake into turn five.

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: Brake at the inside curb, 60% pressure.
corners.line: Take a tighter line close to the inside curb.
corners.exit: Accelerate as you get to the top of the hill.

corners.label: T7
corners.line: Out to mid track before turning in, then close to inside curb.
corners.exit: Accelerate, use right side of track, even pit entry.
corners.mistakes: Going onto the grass too early will spin the car.

general_tips: Stay on left side of track for turn one in qualifying.
Stay on right side of track for turn five in qualifying.
